'''Peg''' (Japanese: '''プルーフ''' ''Proof'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''.

==History==
Peg is a cheerful girl who is an avid fan of the [[Pokémon Baccer World Cup]] team Coronet Fighters, and her [[bag|backpack]] is used to help cheer them on during matches. She is evacuated along with the rest of the city due to Zoroark's attack. Peg bursts in and confirms [[Officer Jenny]]'s explanation of what is happening in [[Crown City]], but does not interact with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} after this. She is seen returning, following [[Grings Kodai|Kodai]]'s defeat, watching the video exposing Kodai's evil schemes and commenting that he's a terrible man for doing such a thing. Peg is last seen cheering for the Coronet Fighters in the Pokémon Baccer World Cup.

Peg's favorite Pokémon are {{p|Magnemite}}, {{p|Magneton}} and {{p|Magnezone}}. Her Magnemite-themed attire is also related to her backing of the Coronet Fighters team; [[Mt. Coronet]] is where Magneton evolves into Magnezone.

Peg made a cameo appearance during the ending credits of [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']].

==Trivia==
* Peg's Japanese name, Proof, is an English translation of another spelling of the name of her Japanese voice actress, Shōko.<ref>http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/news/afreco.html</ref>
* In the dub version of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'', Peg does a cheer and she includes the words Heart and Soul, which is possibly a reference to [[Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions]].
